summary: Frontend-only E2E of Iteration 7 changes: Shipments detail Shipping Instructions edit/save/cancel + Goorin method + upload button, Resources folder redesign, Settings 3-tab (Team/Company/Notifications) toggles, Toasts hover-pause + auto-dismiss, browser Back navigation across pages/sub-views, Dashboard stat-ytd-spend, mobile 390px overflow. ~95% of assertions passed. Confirmed working: si-edit disables si-save when forwarder empty (Freight method); save persists 'DHL Global' + Air + notes and toasts 'Shipping instructions updated · factory notified'; si-cancel restores; si-method-goorin hides forwarder fields and saves with 'Goorin arranges'; shipment-upload visible/clickable; coo-toggle-detail works; chat-input Enter posts chat-msg-0; shipment-back returns to list. Resources: all 4 folder cards (ss27/fw26/brand/sales), ss27 shows Latest badge, resources-folder header + 4 files, res-filter 'lookbook' -> 1 row, res-share-f1 adds Shared pill + toast, res-dl-f1 toast, res-back returns. Settings: team-access default tab; Company preferences toggles (po/ship/reorder/coo/inv) flip aria-checked with toast; Notifications tab shows toggle-confirm. Toasts: hover adds is-paused class; auto-dismiss ~4s; toast-close dismisses individual toast. Back nav: Dashboard->Marketplace->My Orders pushes #my-orders, go_back -> marketplace-page, go_back -> #dashboard; SO56680 detail go_back closes detail keeping orders list. Dashboard: stat-ytd-spend renders $4,563.00 (visible) with bars and Year-to-Date toggle. Mobile 390: ShipmentsDetail si-form fits (scrollWidth==clientWidth==390), Resources folder table also renders 390 (previous iteration's 532 overflow appears resolved for folder view).

ui_bugs.issue: Hard reload on a deep hash (e.g. #shipments, #my-orders, #resources) ALWAYS lands on Dashboard and rewrites the URL to #dashboard. RCA: two useEffects race at mount. The first effect [line 206-213] depends on `activeNav` (initial value 'Dashboard') and runs FIRST — it sees `history.state?.nav !== 'Dashboard'` (state is null on cold load) and pushes `#dashboard` via history.pushState, overwriting the real hash. Only THEN does the mount-only effect [line 215-223] read location.hash (now '#dashboard') and cannot recover the original 'Shipments' route. Fix: read the hash BEFORE the first render (initialize `useState(() => hashToNav())`) OR guard the activeNav effect from running until after the hash-init effect has resolved (e.g. `const [hydrated, setHydrated] = useState(false)`).

Spec expects a 'View details' BUTTON on each row; implementation renders it as `View details` inside the row. The row is keyboard-focusable and Enter/click triggers detail via onClick on , so functionally OK, but the text is not a real interactive element (no button role, no data-testid). Minor a11y concern — screen readers announce it as static text.

action_items: HIGH: Fix hash-bootstrap race in App.tsx so that reloading on #shipments (or any deep hash) lands on the correct page instead of resetting to Dashboard. Suggested fix: derive initial activeNav from location.hash inside useState initializer, or wrap the activeNav push effect with a `hydrated` guard set true only after the mount hash-read effect.
LOW: Consider promoting `.sh-view` to a real <button> or add role="button" + tabindex + data-testid for a11y/testability (currently the parent <tr> handles the click).
critical_code_review_comments: App.tsx: The two hash-related useEffects have an execution-order race. Effect on `activeNav` (line 206) runs before the mount-only hash-init effect (line 215), so any deep-link hash present on cold load is overwritten by the default `activeNav='Dashboard'` before the init effect can pick it up. Deep-link routing is essentially broken on reload.

App.tsx: The useEffect at line 215 does `history.replaceState({nav: fromHash ?? 'Dashboard'}, ...)` unconditionally, which would clobber any sub-view state pushed by useBackable (order-detail, shipment-detail, drawer, lightbox). Fortunately this only runs at cold mount, but the interaction with useBackable's state shape should be audited.

ShipmentsPage.tsx: `si-save` disabled logic checks method === 'Freight forwarder' && (!forwarder || !email). Good for freight, but for other methods there's no validation — user can save empty Goorin/Customer picks. Consider validating minimum fields per method.
AccountPages.tsx ResourcesPage.share still uses `navigator.clipboard?.writeText(...).catch(()=>{})` — now catches (good), but consider awaiting so `notify()` order is correct if clipboard is slow.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (one HIGH bug: reload deep-link hash loses page)

context_for_next_testing_agent: 1) Grant clipboard perms before tests: page.context.grant_permissions(['clipboard-read','clipboard-write']). 2) After hard reload (page.reload) the app resets to Dashboard regardless of hash — this is a bug (see action_items). To retest that fix: reload while on #shipments and assert data-testid=shipments-page is visible with hash still '#shipments'. 3) `.sh-view` 'View details' is a <span>, use `text=View details` selector rather than `button:has-text(...)`. 4) Toasts stack; when asserting toast-close, target the specific toast by text: `page.locator('[data-testid="toast"]:has-text("...")').locator('[data-testid="toast-close"]')`. 5) Settings sidebar entry lives under `.sidebar-footer .nav-item:has-text('Settings')`. 6) settingsTabs use class .set-nav-item — click by label text.
rca of the issue: Reload-loses-hash bug RCA: React runs the two useEffects in order of declaration. In App.tsx: effect A (deps=[activeNav], line 206) runs first with the initial value activeNav='Dashboard'. Because window.history.state is null on cold reload, `history.state?.nav !== 'Dashboard'` is true (undefined !== 'Dashboard'), so it calls history.pushState({nav:'Dashboard'}, '', '#dashboard'), REWRITING the URL. Then effect B (deps=[], line 215) reads window.location.hash which is now '#dashboard' — the original '#shipments' is lost. Fix: either (a) initialize `activeNav` lazily from hash: `useState(() => labels.find(l => `#${navSlug(l)}`===location.hash) ?? 'Dashboard')`, or (b) skip effect A on the very first mount using a `hydrated` ref. Option (a) is cleaner.
